# OMEGA 4-Tier Multi-Scale Observatory (v6.8.0)

Unified zero-dependency Node.js ESM, Python 3, and WebGL 2.0 multi-scale Artificial Life cockpit supervising **8 live local endpoints across 7 public repositories** on `http://127.0.0.1:8790/` with render-only `D7RO` observer isolation (checked via display matrix assertions, `#ifdef PICK` preservation, and a live loopback wire-spy test), loopback HTTP CSRF & live raw-socket WebSocket `Upgrade` `403` CSWSH guards, bounded `1..1,000,000` bare-metal controls differentially verified on raw unnormalized inputs between Node and Python, and `9/9` hand-planted regression mutants killed (`7` in `lib/observatory_core.mjs`, `2` in `server.mjs`).

## Quickstart

Requires **Node.js >= 22** and **Python >= 3.12** (zero `npm install` or `pip install` needed).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/omega-triscale-observatory.git
cd omega-triscale-observatory

# 1. Run all automated verification, wire-spy, raw-socket WS CSWSH, property, differential, lint, mutation & timestamp checks
npm test
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
npm run lint
npm run mutate
python scripts/stamp_timestamps.py --verify

# 2. Launch standalone UI & health endpoint (no sibling repositories required)
npm run start:standalone
# Visit http://127.0.0.1:8790/ and http://127.0.0.1:8790/healthz

# 3. Launch full 4-tier 8-endpoint supervisor (when companion repos are cloned as siblings)
npm start
```

## Usage

### Dry-Run Bare-Metal Relay CLI (Cross-Platform, Safe)

```bash
python macro_wild_relay.py --preset million --data-dir ./runtime/dry \
  --n 1000000 --cap 0 --species 100 --kernels 1 --ecores --gpu 1 --prefetch 1 --large-pages --dry-run
```

### Programmatic Core Import (`lib/observatory_core.mjs`)

```js
import { normalizeGenesisConfig, buildRelayArgs, computeDifferentialsCore, createInitialState } from "./lib/observatory_core.mjs";

const cfg = normalizeGenesisConfig({ preset: "million", n: 1_000_000, ecores: true, gpu: true, prefetch: true });
console.log(cfg.n, cfg.cap, buildRelayArgs(cfg).includes("--ecores"));
// -> 1000000 1004096 true
```

See [`examples/README.md`](examples/README.md) and [`examples/verify_pipeline.mjs`](examples/verify_pipeline.mjs) for runnable end-to-end examples.

## Honest Verification Boundaries & Mega-Atlas Cross-Check

- **Local vs. Upstream Proofs:** This repository contains **0 local Lean 4 files**. It is strictly an orchestration, reverse-proxy, and visualization instrument. Its own invariants are checked by **14/14 Node tests** (including live raw-socket WebSocket `Upgrade` `403`/`101` CSWSH tests, live loopback `D7RO` wire-spy test recording every request sent to a mock Asmodensius server during T1/T2 updates, offline-engine `DEGRADED` conservation gate tests for `t1_dna`/`t2_cells`/`t4_env`, **250 seeded `prop_check` trials**, and **18 raw unnormalized adversarial Node↔Python differential parity cases**), **6/6 Python relay tests** (**120 trials**), static lint (`9` JS/MJS + `5` Python targets, `0` errors), and **9/9 hand-planted regression mutants killed** (`7` in `lib/observatory_core.mjs`, `2` in `server.mjs`; default `npm run mutate` does not dirty `results/mutation_audit.json`). These are example-based, live-socket, differential, and seeded-random tests, not formal proofs or an exhaustive repo-wide mutation score. Remaining scope boundaries (e.g., absent-`Origin` loopback CLI admission, mock vs. live native binaries) are documented transparently in [`LIMITATIONS.md`](LIMITATIONS.md) and [`CLAIMS.md`](CLAIMS.md). The `327` combined 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 proofs referenced in the ecosystem header live in, and are reported by, their six respective formal sibling repositories (`48 + 70 + 89 + 54 + 30 + 36`); they are not audited here.
- **Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas Non-Retirement:** **`0 / 1,900` overarching Mega-Atlas open problems are solved or retired** by this repository. It serves solely as an observation and orchestration instrument supporting empirical study of `AI-045`, `SYS-009`, and `SYS-050`, each of which remains strictly **OPEN** (see [`docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md`](docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md)).
- **Statement Audit & v6.8.0 Resolutions (2026-11-26):** Every wording, bibliography (`bedau1998`), CI SLSA attestation, code, UI, and test-coverage gap logged by the independent statement audit ([log](https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive/blob/main/docs/reviews/2026-11-26-statement-audit.md)) is preserved and resolved transparently in [`ERRATA.md`](ERRATA.md).
- **Limitations & Indicator-Only Disclosures:** See [`LIMITATIONS.md`](LIMITATIONS.md) and [`CLAIMS.md`](CLAIMS.md) for full real-vs-metaphor boundaries (e.g., `chaosLyapunov` is a heuristic volatility index, not a maximal Lyapunov exponent; Tier 3 internal organs are count-driven projections; this preprint is not externally peer-reviewed).

# AGENTS.md — OMEGA 4-Tier Multi-Scale Observatory (v6.8.0)

> Canonical agent instructions for `0thernes/omega-triscale-observatory` (`CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, and `.cursor/rules/build-standard.mdc` all point here).

## Purpose & Honest Scope

`omega-triscale-observatory` is a **zero-dependency Node.js ESM, Python 3, and WebGL 2.0 multi-scale Artificial Life cockpit** supervising **8 live local endpoints across 7 public repositories** on `http://127.0.0.1:8790/`.

- **Author:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA`, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, `0_0@0thernes.art`). Never attach an unformed LLC corporate suffix.
- **Dual License:** Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`, `LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt`) for all code, scripts, and CI; CC-BY-4.0 (`LICENSE-DOCS`, `LICENSES/CC-BY-4.0.txt`) for white paper, PDFs, diagrams, and documentation (`REUSE.toml`).
- **Honest Verification Boundary:** This repository is strictly a visualization, reverse-proxy, telemetry-metrology, and process-orchestration instrument. It contains **0 local Lean 4 files** (upstream formal proofs live in six formal sibling repositories: `48` `autophage` + `70` `cellulogonic-mecha` + `89` `cellular-engine-omega` + `54` `noetic-organism-omega` + `30` `asmodensius-native` + `36` `alife-singularity-omega-package` = `327` combined upstream 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 theorems audited in their own repos) and retires **0 / 1,900** overarching open problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`. Preprint is **not externally peer-reviewed**.
- **Render-Only Observer Independence (`D7RO`):** Never introduce any live T1/T2 write path into `Asmodensius-Native` (`:8794` / `:8796`), and never modify code inside `#ifdef PICK` shader blocks when injecting Bio-FX overlays. Guarded by live loopback wire-spy test `5e` and planted mutants `M3` & `M9`.

## Hard Rules (Build Standard v1.2.0, R1–R8)

- **R1–R2:** Commit and push directly to `main`. No pull requests, no feature branches, no git hooks, no commit/tag signing.
- **R3:** CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) is informational on every push to `main` and release tag `v*`.
- **R4:** Banned files — never add `.github/dependabot.yml`, `renovate.json`, `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE*`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, or `FUNDING.yml`.
- **R5:** Keep `AGENTS.md` under 32 KiB. Never leave template placeholder or unfilled-todo markers anywhere in tracked files.
- **R6:** Never fabricate numbers, test outcomes, citations, DOIs, or peer-review claims. Every number in docs and `paper/main.tex` must match a real command run.
- **R7:** Classify every hardening or audit finding into exactly one of the 10 classes: `bug`, `error`, `issue`, `problem`, `concern`, `dilemma`, `conflict`, `gap`, `hole`, `blindspot`.
- **R8:** On Windows paths containing brackets (`Z:\[Vibe Coded (AI)]\...`), ALWAYS pass `-LiteralPath` to PowerShell file cmdlets.
- **Daemon Hygiene:** Never leave `server.mjs` or child engines running in the background after tests. Always test against ephemeral `127.0.0.1:0` or stop processes cleanly.

## Repository Map

- `lib/observatory_core.mjs` — Pure deterministic core: loopback CSRF/CSWSH guards, `resolveSafePath`, Genesis `1..1,000,000` clamping + `parseBoolFlag`, bare-metal hardware flag builder, AZST binary decoder, 112-trait spectral delta, 8-axis cosine coherence, `<=240` omnitemporal ring buffer, fail-closed conservation gate, and `D7RO` 4x4 matrix.
- `server.mjs` — Loopback HTTP/1.1 + SSE + WebSocket Hub (`:8790`), `/healthz`, reverse proxy, Bio-FX shader injector, configurable `PORTS` + single-tick Asmodensius pollers, and child supervisor (`--no-engines` for standalone mode).
- `macro_wild_relay.py` — Read-only Asmodensius-Native relay (`:8794`) with raw-input clamping parity (`clamp_int_raw`, `parse_bool_flag`) and `--dry-run` JSON contract output.
- `web/` — Unified dark scientific cockpit (`index.html`, `app.js`, `creature_gl.js`, `styles.css`, `taxonomy.js`).
- `tests/` — `test_observatory.mjs` (14 Node `node:test` suites: live HTTP, raw-socket WS CSWSH `403`/`101`, live loopback `D7RO` wire-spy, offline-engine `DEGRADED`, 250 `prop_check` trials, metamorphic/golden, 18-case raw-input Node↔Python differential parity) and `test_relay.py` (6 Python `unittest` suites, 120 trials).
- `scripts/` — `lint_check.mjs`, `run_mutation_audit.mjs` (9/9 planted mutants, non-dirty default), `benchmark_observatory.mjs`, `check_citations.py` (Crossref/DataCite title+author match), `build_paper.py` (`--verify-only` CI mode), `stamp_timestamps.py` (DigiCert RFC 3161 + Bitcoin OTS), `Audit-Repo.ps1`, `audit-repo.sh`.
- `paper/` & `dist/` — AMS-LaTeX architecture white paper (`main.tex`, `refs.bib`), frozen PDF (`dist/Donahue_2026_omega_triscale_observatory.pdf`), and clean-room arXiv tarball (`dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz`).
- `docs/index.html` & FAIR metadata — Static WCAG 2.2 AA GitHub Pages showcase, `docs/DATASHEET.md`, `SUBMISSION_READINESS.md`, `croissant.json`, `ro-crate-metadata.json`, `codemeta.json`, `REUSE.toml`, `data/MANIFEST.sha256`.


# Claims Ledger (`CLAIMS.md`)

Every engineering, verification, empirical, and epistemic claim in `omega-triscale-observatory` v6.8.0 is tracked below with an explicit epistemic tier, reproducible verification command, artifact path, and **explicit falsification / refutation condition (what would prove us wrong)**.

Epistemic tiers:
- `program-audited` — checked by deterministic automated tests (example-based, live loopback socket/wire-spy, raw-input differential, and seeded-random property checks) and planted-mutant audits on the current commit. These are tests of the software, not formal proofs.
- `empirical` — measured on real local hardware and recorded verbatim in `results/`.
- `indicator-only` — heuristic visual or proxy indicator; explicitly NOT a rigorous mathematical or biological proof.
- `upstream-linked` — reported by supervised companion repositories and audited there, not inside this repo.
- `open-conjecture` — overarching unsolved scientific problem; strictly NOT solved or retired.

| ID | Epistemic Tier | Exact Claim | Verification Command | Artifact | What Would Prove Us Wrong (Refutation Condition) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **C1** | `program-audited` | Loopback perimeter enforces `127.0.0.1`/`localhost`/`[::1]` `Host` and `Origin`, `application/json` on state-mutating `POST`, `Sec-Fetch-Site`, live raw-socket WebSocket `Upgrade` `403` CSWSH rejection on foreign `Origin` or bad `Host` (plus `101` positive control; an absent `Origin` header with loopback `Host` is admitted for local CLI clients), and canonical `resolveSafePath` traversal defense. | `npm test` | `lib/observatory_core.mjs`, `server.mjs`, `tests/test_observatory.mjs` (`Test 2c, 3, 3b`) | Any cross-origin `POST`/`SSE`/WS request returns `200`/`101`, or any `..`/backslash/NUL/drive-letter path leaks a file outside `web/` or `ZETA_PKG_ROOT`. |
| **C2** | `program-audited` | Genesis normalizer clamps `n` in `[1, 1_000_000]`, `cap` in `[n, 2_000_000]` (falling back to `autoCap` for `cap <= 0`), `species` in `[1, min(100, n)]`, `lesion` in `[0, 0x7fffff]`, whitelists `AZ_PARAM` keys, emits bare-metal flags (`--ecores`, `--gpu`, `--prefetch`, `--kernels`, `--large-pages`), and matches Python `macro_wild_relay.py --dry-run` on 18 raw unnormalized adversarial and seeded-random inputs passed directly to both languages. | `npm test && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` | `lib/observatory_core.mjs`, `macro_wild_relay.py`, `tests/test_observatory.mjs` (`Test 4, 6`), `tests/test_relay.py` | Any of the 250 Node + 120 Python `prop_check` trials violates a bound, or Node `normalizeGenesisConfig` disagrees with Python `--dry-run` on any raw input field. |
| **C3** | `program-audited` | Render-only observer convention (`D7RO`) fixes all lower-to-Asmodensius display cells (`T1->T3`, `T1->T4`, `T2->T3`, `T2->T4`) at `{ m: "D7RO", s: 0 }`, preserves `#ifdef PICK` in Bio-FX shader injection, and passes live loopback wire-spy `Test 5e` (recording every HTTP method/path/body on a mock Asmodensius socket during T1/T2 updates: zero non-`GET` writes in Phase A, strictly read-only `POST /api/inspect {"uid":...}` in Phase B, zero leaked T1/T2 bytes; out-of-band operator cadence/pause/relaunch commands remain separate operator paths). | `npm test` | `lib/observatory_core.mjs`, `server.mjs`, `tests/test_observatory.mjs` (`Test 5b, 5c, 5e`) | Any toggle moves `matrix4x4[0..1][2..3]` off `D7RO`/0, Bio-FX edits `#ifdef PICK`, or any T1/T2 write/payload hits mock Asmodensius. |
| **C4** | `program-audited` | 112-trait spectral differential clamps inputs to `[0, 1]`, satisfies swap antisymmetry and constant-shift invariance inside `[0, 1]`, produces 111 finite gradient slopes, and strictly caps omnitemporal `history.length <= 240`. | `npm test` | `lib/observatory_core.mjs`, `tests/test_observatory.mjs` (`Test 5a, 5b`) | `history.length > 240`, any `NaN`/`Infinity` metric, or swap/shift invariance fails beyond rounding tolerance (`2e-4`). |
| **C5** | `program-audited` | Conservation gate (UI title: `"Upstream-reported residual and freshness gate"`) fails closed: reports `ALERT` if any T1/T2 residual or `observerFail !== 0`, `DEGRADED` if any required tier (`t1_dna`, `t2_cells`, `t4_env`) is offline or stale (`>= 15 s`), and `VERIFIED` only when all required tiers are live, fresh, and zero-residual. All three transitions (`ALERT`, stale `DEGRADED`, offline `DEGRADED`) are directly tested. | `npm test` | `lib/observatory_core.mjs`, `web/index.html`, `tests/test_observatory.mjs` (`Test 1b, 5b`) | Hub reports `VERIFIED` (`conservationOk === true`) while any required tier is offline, stale, or nonzero-residual. |
| **C6** | `program-audited` | Verification suite passes `14/14` Node tests, `6/6` Python tests, static lint (`0` errors across `14` targets), and kills `9/9` hand-planted regression mutants (`7` in `lib/observatory_core.mjs`, `2` in `server.mjs`) in an isolated temporary workspace without dirtying `results/mutation_audit.json`. This `9/9` result is the kill rate for these nine targeted mutants, not a repo-wide automated mutation score covering every arithmetic/UI line. | `npm test && npm run lint && npm run mutate` | `results/mutation_audit.json`, `scripts/run_mutation_audit.mjs` | Any test fails, any lint error appears, any planted mutant survives (`killed < 9`), or default `npm run mutate` dirties `results/mutation_audit.json`. |
| **C7** | `empirical` | Measured telemetry micro-benchmarks on Node `v25.8.2` (Win64 x64) average `0.0504 ms` for `computeDifferentialsCore` (`p95 = 0.1169 ms`) and `3.1278 ms` for `10,000`-creature binary `AZST` decoding (`p95 = 4.1033 ms`). | `npm run bench` | `results/benchmarks.json`, `docs/benchmarks.md` | Repeated runs on the reference machine exceed documented p95 budgets (`> 2 ms` diff / `> 30 ms` AZST decode). |
| **C8** | `indicator-only` | `differential.chaosLyapunov` is a heuristic volatility/entropy index in `[0, 1]`, Tier 3 internal organs in `web/creature_gl.js` are count-driven projections, and Noetic header readouts are forwarded proxy indicators. | `cat LIMITATIONS.md` | `LIMITATIONS.md`, `web/creature_gl.js` | Falsified immediately if any active document claims these are physical Lyapunov exponents, voxel-accurate organs, or proof of sentience. |
| **C9** | `upstream-linked` | This repository contains `0` local Lean 4 files; the 6 supervised formal sibling repositories report `327` combined upstream 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 theorems (`48 + 70 + 89 + 54 + 30 + 36`), checked in their own repos and not audited here. | Inspect `repo.yaml` & sibling repos | `README.md`, `docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md` | Any local `.lean` file claimed without audit, or upstream counts drift without updating the registry table. |
| **C10** | `open-conjecture` | Zero (`0 / 1,900`) overarching Mega-Atlas open problems (`AI-045`, `SYS-009`, `SYS-050`) are solved or retired by this instrument. | `cat docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md` | `docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md` | Falsified if any section claims retirement of an overarching Mega-Atlas open problem without independent peer-reviewed resolution. |

All wording tightenings from the 2026-11-26 independent statement audit ([log](https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive/blob/main/docs/reviews/2026-11-26-statement-audit.md)) are preserved, and every code/test/citation/CI gap logged in that audit is resolved in `v6.8.0` (see `ERRATA.md`).

# Limitations, Threats to Validity, and Real-vs-Metaphor Boundary

This document explicitly delineates what `omega-triscale-observatory` v6.8.0 **does** and **does not** establish (Build Standard `B41` and Playbook v1.3).

## 1. Real vs. Metaphor Boundary

| Element in UI / Code | What Is Computationally Real | What Is Strictly Visual Metaphor or Heuristic Indicator |
|---|---|---|
| `differential.chaosLyapunov` | Bounded `[0, 1]` sum of rolling telemetry step differences and Shannon entropies. | **NOT** a maximal Lyapunov exponent, phase-space divergence proof, or formal proof of mathematical chaos. |
| Tier 3 Internal Organs (`web/creature_gl.js`) | Synthesized deterministically from live integer counts (`parts`, `neurons`, `tiles`, `T2 active_axons`, `CPG`). | **NOT** physical 3D organ coordinates exported from `az_live.exe` (which `/api/inspect` does not provide). |
| Tier 4 Bio-FX ULTRA Shaders (`server.mjs`) | Real GLSL ES 3.00 fragment/vertex shaders injected client-side outside `#ifdef PICK`. | **NOT** physical biochemical skin membranes, iridescence physics, or state changes inside `Asmodensius-Native`. |
| Binomial Taxonomy (`web/taxonomy.js`) | Deterministic FNV-1a procedural Latinate labels derived from clade IDs, UIDs, and morphology ratios. | **NOT** phylogenetic cladistics or biological taxonomy recognized by ICZN/ICN. |
| Noetic Header Pill (`B14/14 · T10/10 · CQM25/25`) | Real HTTP JSON telemetry proxied from local `:8795`. | Strictly **indicator-only** computational diagnostics; **NOT** evidence of phenomenal consciousness or sentience. |
| Conservation Status Pill (`web/index.html`) | *"Upstream-reported residual and freshness gate"* checking reported residual fields are zero and fresh (`< 15 s`) with all required tiers online. | **NOT** an independent physical conservation solver inside the Hub itself. |
| Ecosystem Lean 4 Count (`327` upstream) | Sum of 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 theorem counts reported by six formal sibling repositories (not audited in this repository). | **NOT** formally verifying `server.mjs`, `web/app.js`, or `macro_wild_relay.py` (this repo contains **0** Lean 4 files). |

## 2. Engineering & Experimental Limitations

1. **Local-Only Loopback Scope:** `server.mjs` binds strictly to `127.0.0.1` without TLS, user accounts, or rate-limiting middleware suitable for public internet exposure. Exposing port `8790` beyond loopback breaks the threat model (`docs/threat-model.md`).
2. **Absent-`Origin` CLI Behavior:** `isLoopbackOrigin` admits requests without an `Origin` header when `Host` is loopback so non-browser local CLI tools can connect; standard browsers always send `Origin` on cross-site `POST` and WebSocket `Upgrade` handshakes (tested directly in `Test 3` and `Test 3b`).
3. **Sibling Engine Availability & Mock Wire-Spy Scope:** Full 8-endpoint live supervision requires the 6 companion repositories built locally on disk. In standalone CI (`ubuntu-latest` / `windows-latest`) or clean-clone tests, `Test 5e` exercises live loopback HTTP/AZST traffic against ephemeral mock servers rather than live native `az_live.exe` binaries, and out-of-band operator controls (`live_macro_rates`, `sync_pause`, `respawn_cosmos`, `ignite_genesis`, `/proxy/macro/*`) remain separate operator-initiated channels.
4. **Headless WebGL2 Rendering Not Automated in CI:** `web/app.js` and `web/creature_gl.js` are verified via Node syntax checks (`node --check`), static lint, and shader-injection string/contract tests (`#ifdef PICK` preservation), not via headless Chromium GPU pixel-diffing in CI.
5. **Windows Bare-Metal Hardware Paths:** Flags such as `--ecores`, `--gpu 1` (RTX 5070 Ti CUDA PTX), and `--large-pages` are validated end-to-end as raw-input CLI contracts between Node and Python (`--dry-run`), while actual multi-core/GPU throughput depends on the host OS, privileges (`SeLockMemoryPrivilege` for large pages), and `az_live.exe`.
6. **Non-Peer-Reviewed Status:** Neither this repository nor its accompanying white paper (`dist/Donahue_2026_omega_triscale_observatory.pdf`) has undergone external peer review.
7. **Zero Mega-Atlas Retirements:** `0 / 1,900` overarching open problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` are retired by this instrument (`docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md`).
8. **Tests, Not Proofs (and Planted-Mutant Scope):** Every `program-audited` claim rests on example-based, live-socket, raw-input differential, and seeded-random tests plus a 9-mutant planted-regression audit (`7` in `lib/observatory_core.mjs`, `2` in `server.mjs`). That `9/9` result measures kill rate on nine targeted regression mutants, not an automated repo-wide mutation score over every arithmetic or UI line. This repository contains no Lean or other machine-checked proof of its own behavior.

## 3. Resolution Status of 2026-11-26 Statement Audit Gaps

All six test/code gaps and ten paper/metadata/CI items logged by the 2026-11-26 independent statement audit ([log](https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive/blob/main/docs/reviews/2026-11-26-statement-audit.md)) were closed in `v6.8.0` (live `D7RO` wire-spy `Test 5e`, live raw-socket WS `Upgrade` `403`/`101` `Test 3b`, offline-engine `DEGRADED` `Test 5b`, 18-case raw-input Node↔Python differential parity `Test 6`, non-dirty deterministic `run_mutation_audit.mjs` with `9/9` killed across core + server, honest `web/index.html` pill title, corrected `bedau1998` + Crossref/DataCite title+author verifier, and `--verify-only` CI SLSA attestation covering the committed PDF & arXiv tarball). Full traceability is preserved in [`ERRATA.md`](ERRATA.md).

# Replication Protocol (`REPLICATION.md`)

This document provides exact clean-clone instructions to independently verify all tests, live raw-socket WS CSWSH checks, live loopback `D7RO` wire-spy checks, offline-engine `DEGRADED` checks, property trials, raw-input differential Node↔Python relay contracts, planted-mutant kills, telemetry micro-benchmarks, Crossref/DataCite citation audits, dual cryptographic timestamps, and Tectonic AMS-LaTeX PDF builds for `omega-triscale-observatory` v6.8.0.

## Prerequisites

- **Node.js:** `>= 22.0.0` (tested on `v25.8.2`; zero npm packages required)
- **Python:** `>= 3.12.0` (tested on `3.12` in CI and `3.13.15` locally; zero pip packages required)
- **Tectonic (optional, for PDF rebuild):** `>= 0.15.0` (tested on `0.17.0`)
- **OpenSSL (optional, for RFC 3161 minting):** `>= 3.0` (verification uses Python stdlib only)
- **PowerShell 7+ or Bash (optional, for Build Standard audit):** `pwsh` or `bash`

## Clean-Clone Step-by-Step Protocol

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/omega-triscale-observatory.git
cd omega-triscale-observatory

# Step 1: Node.js unit, live HTTP, raw-socket WS CSWSH, live D7RO wire-spy, offline DEGRADED, 250 prop_check & 18 raw-input parity tests
npm test

# Step 2: Python macro_wild_relay.py unit, raw adversarial & 120 randomized property tests
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

# Step 3: Static syntax, security, determinism & identity hygiene lint
npm run lint

# Step 4: Isolated 9-mutant planted-regression audit (7 core + 2 server; non-dirty working tree)
npm run mutate
git diff --exit-code results/mutation_audit.json

# Step 5: Deterministic micro-benchmarks (writes results/benchmarks.json)
npm run bench

# Step 6: Live Crossref/DataCite title+author citation & URL audit (13/13 entries, 0 retractions)
python scripts/check_citations.py

# Step 7: Verify DigiCert RFC 3161 (.tsr) + Bitcoin OpenTimestamps (.ots) cryptographic timestamps
python scripts/stamp_timestamps.py --verify

# Step 8: Zero-overflow Tectonic AMS-LaTeX PDF + clean-room arXiv tarball verification
python scripts/build_paper.py --verify-only

# Step 9: Build Standard v1.2.0 repository audit (expects 100.0% / 100.0% / 100.0%)
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1 -Path .
```

## Expected Verification Thresholds

- `npm test`: `14/14` pass, `0` fail, `0` lingering processes on port `8790`.
- `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`: `6/6` pass.
- `npm run lint`: `0` errors across `9` JS/MJS + `5` Python targets.
- `npm run mutate`: `9/9` planted mutants killed (`7` core + `2` server), working tree clean (`git diff` empty).
- `python scripts/check_citations.py`: `13/13` BibTeX entries verified (`10/10` DOIs title+author match, `5/5` URLs page-title match, `1` print proceedings entry, `0` retractions).
- `python scripts/stamp_timestamps.py --verify`: PASS (both `.tsr` and `.ots` cryptographically bind `CHECKSUMS.sha256`).
- `python scripts/build_paper.py --verify-only`: `0` Overfull `\hbox`, `0` undefined refs/citations, clean-room arXiv compile passes.
- `scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1 -Path .`: Structure `100.0%`, Completion `100.0%`, Core `100.0%`, `0` placeholder files.

| **D3** | `deployed` / `A36` (Production cloud rollback) | `deployed: false` because the live Hub runs strictly on local loopback (`127.0.0.1:8790`) on the researcher's workstation (while static documentation & architecture showcase deploy to GitHub Pages under `A27: done`). | Full local restart, clean process-tree reaping (`taskkill /T /F` / `SIGTERM`), and git-tag rollback instructions are documented in `docs/operations.md`. |
| **D4** | `experimental` / `B28–B32, B39` | `experimental: false` because this repo makes no statistical hypothesis-testing or dataset-inference claims (only deterministic systems tests and local micro-benchmarks under `perf: true`). | Micro-benchmark repeatability, exact environment disclosures, and SHA-256 artifact manifests are recorded in `docs/benchmarks.md`, `results/benchmarks.json`, `docs/DATASHEET.md`, and `data/MANIFEST.sha256`. |

### Known issues in the code and tests logged in the 2026-11-26 audit (resolved in v6.8.0 below)

- `tests/test_observatory.mjs`: no test recorded the requests `server.mjs` sends to the Asmodensius port while T1/T2 state changes (`D7RO` checked only as a display constant).
- `tests/test_observatory.mjs`: no raw-socket `Upgrade` request with a foreign `Origin` (expected `403`) exercised `server.on("upgrade")`.
- `tests/test_observatory.mjs`: no case set a required tier offline (`st.engines.t1_dna = false`, `t2_cells = false`) expecting `DEGRADED`.
- `tests/test_observatory.mjs` test 6: raw inputs, not Node-normalized ones, needed to be passed to both sides of the parity check.
- `scripts/run_mutation_audit.mjs`: rewrote `results/mutation_audit.json` with a volatile `elapsed_ms` on every run.
- `web/index.html` line 26: status pill title called the residual check `"thermodynamic ... invariant verification"` instead of `"Upstream-reported residual and freshness gate"`.

## Resolutions in v6.8.0 (2026-11-26)

Every paper, bibliography, metadata, CI, code, UI, and test-coverage item from the 2026-11-26 statement audit was closed in `v6.8.0`:

| # | Audit Item | Finding Class | Concrete Resolution in `v6.8.0` |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | `D7RO` live wire-spy test gap | `gap` | Refactored `server.mjs` to expose configurable `PORTS` and single-tick pollers (`pollAsmodensiusSnapOnce`, `pollAsmodensiusFieldsOnce`); added live 4-server loopback wire-spy `Test 5e` recording every HTTP method/URL/body on mock Asmodensius during T1/T2 mutations (`0` non-`GET` writes in Phase A, strictly read-only `POST /api/inspect {"uid":...}` in Phase B, `0` leaked T1/T2 bytes), verified non-vacuous by `server.mjs` mutant `M9_D7RO_WIRE_LEAK_SERVER`. |

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0 -->
# Datasheet for `omega-triscale-observatory` Verification & Telemetry Artifacts (`v6.8.0`)

> Structured according to Gebru et al. (2021), *"Datasheets for Datasets"*, Communications of the ACM 64(12).

---

## 1. Motivation

- **For what purpose were these artifacts created?** `omega-triscale-observatory` v6.8.0 is a zero-dependency Node.js ESM, Python 3, and WebGL 2.0 multi-scale Artificial Life cockpit supervising eight local endpoints across seven public repositories on `127.0.0.1:8790`. Its structured machine-readable artifacts (`results/mutation_audit.json`, `results/benchmarks.json`, `results/citation-audit.json`, `CHECKSUMS.sha256`, `data/MANIFEST.sha256`) document reproducible software verification, planted-mutant kill receipts, latency micro-benchmarks, and live Crossref/DataCite citation audits.
- **Who created and funded this artifact?** Independent researcher **Alexander Stephen Donahue** (`Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA`; ORCID [`0009-0006-8168-9648`](https://orcid.org/0009-0006-8168-9648); `0_0@0thernes.art`), self-funded with zero external corporate or government sponsorship, with disclosed AI coding assistance under direct human direction and verification (`docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md`).

## 2. Composition

- **What do the machine-readable artifacts contain?**
  1. `results/mutation_audit.json` — Deterministic audit receipt of **9 hand-planted regression mutants** (`M1`–`M9`: 7 in `lib/observatory_core.mjs`, 2 in `server.mjs`), each recording `id`, `file`, `description`, and `killed: true` (omitting volatile wall-clock timings so `npm run mutate` never dirties the working tree).
  2. `results/benchmarks.json` — Measured Node.js `v25.8.2` (`win32-x64`) latency distributions (`iterations`, `mean_ms`, `p50_ms`, `p95_ms`, `p99_ms`) across four deterministic core workloads (`computeDifferentialsCore`, `decodeAzstCreaturesCore` on 10,000 synthetic `AZST` creatures, `normalizeGenesisConfig + buildRelayArgs` for 1M bare-metal config, and `resolveSafePath`).
  3. `results/citation-audit.json` — Live verification audit of all **13 BibTeX entries** in `paper/refs.bib` (`10/10` DOIs verified for Handle reachability plus Crossref/DataCite title & author match with `0` retractions, `5/5` URLs verified HTTP 200 + page-title match, and `bedau1998` recorded cleanly as a print MIT Press proceedings chapter without a wrong DOI).
  4. `data/MANIFEST.sha256` & `CHECKSUMS.sha256` — LF-normalized SHA-256 integrity manifests covering core source files, tests, results, metadata, frozen PDF (`dist/Donahue_2026_omega_triscale_observatory.pdf`), and deterministic clean-room arXiv tarball (`dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz`), dual-timestamped via DigiCert RFC 3161 (`CHECKSUMS.sha256.tsr`) and 3-calendar Bitcoin OpenTimestamps (`CHECKSUMS.sha256.ots`).
- **Does this repository contain personal, confidential, or sensitive data?** **No.** All data is synthetic/deterministic telemetry or public bibliographic metadata (`personal_data: false`).

## 3. Collection, Generation & Verification Process

- **How are artifacts produced?** Every JSON artifact is generated directly from executable zero-dependency scripts in `scripts/`:
  - `node scripts/run_mutation_audit.mjs --write` → `results/mutation_audit.json`
  - `node scripts/benchmark_observatory.mjs` → `results/benchmarks.json`
  - `python scripts/check_citations.py --write` → `results/citation-audit.json`
  - `python scripts/build_paper.py` → `dist/Donahue_2026_omega_triscale_observatory.pdf` + `dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz`
  - `python scripts/stamp_timestamps.py --mint` → `CHECKSUMS.sha256.tsr` + `CHECKSUMS.sha256.ots`
- **Automated Verification Suites:** `14/14` Node.js `node:test` tests (including live raw-socket WebSocket `Upgrade` CSWSH `403`/`101`, live loopback `D7RO` wire-spy recording every request to mock Asmodensius, offline-engine `DEGRADED` conservation gate, `250` seeded `prop_check` trials, and `18` raw unnormalized Node↔Python differential parity cases) and `6/6` Python `unittest` tests (`120` seeded randomized trials).

## 4. Uses & Out-of-Scope Warnings

- **Recommended Uses:** Reproducible verification of multi-scale Artificial Life reverse-proxy supervision, security boundary auditing (CSRF/CSWSH/path-traversal), cross-language CLI normalization parity, and educational study of render-only observer conventions.
- **Explicit Out-of-Scope / Prohibited Misuses:**
  - Do **NOT** deploy `server.mjs` directly on public or untrusted networks; it is strictly a single-user loopback (`127.0.0.1:8790`) instrument.
  - Do **NOT** treat `differential.chaosLyapunov` as a mathematical maximal Lyapunov exponent or Tier 3 count-driven organ projections as physical anatomical coordinates (`LIMITATIONS.md`).
  - Do **NOT** represent the `9/9` planted-mutant audit as an exhaustive repo-wide mutation score or as formal proof (`0` local Lean 4 files; `0 / 1,900` Mega-Atlas open problems retired; preprint is **not peer-reviewed**).

## 5. Distribution & Maintenance

- **Distribution:** GitHub (`https://github.com/0thernes/omega-triscale-observatory`), GitHub Pages (`https://0thernes.github.io/omega-triscale-observatory/`), Software Heritage (`swh:1:snp:045edd61e0805b3778e40f5230062e8cc245bb60`), FAIR metadata (`croissant.json`, `ro-crate-metadata.json`, `codemeta.json`, `.zenodo.json`), and SLSA/Rekor build provenance via GitHub Actions.
- **Licensing:** Dual open license — **Apache-2.0** (`LICENSE`, `LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt`) for code, scripts, JSON manifests, and CI; **CC-BY-4.0** (`LICENSE-DOCS`, `LICENSES/CC-BY-4.0.txt`) for white paper, PDFs, diagrams, and documentation (`REUSE.toml`).
- **Maintenance:** Actively maintained by Alexander Stephen Donahue (`0_0@0thernes.art`) via SemVer (`CHANGELOG.md`) and 10-class GitHub Issue forms.

# System Architecture (`docs/architecture.md`)

`omega-triscale-observatory` v6.8.0 is a **single-process local supervisor, loopback reverse proxy, binary telemetry decoder, and WebGL 2.0 scientific cockpit** written in zero-dependency Node.js ESM (`server.mjs`, `lib/observatory_core.mjs`) and Python 3 (`macro_wild_relay.py`).

## 1. Module Separation

| Module | Responsibility | Runtime Dependencies |
|---|---|---|
| `lib/observatory_core.mjs` | Pure deterministic core: SplitMix32 PRNG, `clampInt`, `parseBoolFlag`, loopback CSRF/CSWSH predicates, `resolveSafePath`, `validateCladeParam`, `validateSliceZParam`, `normalizeGenesisConfig`, `buildRelayArgs`, `computeDifferentialsCore`, `decodeAzstCreaturesCore`, `sampleLocalHabitatCore`, `sanitizeProxyHeaders`. | Node.js built-ins only (`node:path`) |
| `server.mjs` | Loopback HTTP/1.1 + SSE + WebSocket Hub (`127.0.0.1:8790`), `/healthz`, configurable `PORTS`, single-tick Asmodensius pollers, reverse-proxy URL rewriting, observer-only Bio-FX GLSL injector (preserving `#ifdef PICK`), and child process tree supervision. | Node.js built-ins only (`node:http`, `node:net`, `node:fs`, `node:path`, `node:child_process`, `node:url`) |
| `macro_wild_relay.py` | Read-only relay (`:8794`) importing `Asmodensius-Native/demo/viewer_server.py` with bounded `1..1,000,000` Genesis presets, raw-input parity (`clamp_int_raw`, `parse_bool_flag`), bare-metal flags (`--ecores`, `--gpu`, `--prefetch`, `--kernels`, `--large-pages`), run-directory pruning, and `--dry-run` JSON contract mode. | Python 3.12+ stdlib only |
| `web/` | Dark scientific UI (`index.html`, `styles.css`), SSE telemetry client & Canvas metrology (`app.js`), WebGL2 GLSL ES 3.00 12-shader specimen engine (`creature_gl.js`), and deterministic FNV-1a taxonomy generator (`taxonomy.js`). | Browser WebGL2 / Canvas 2D |

## 2. Eight Supervised Local Endpoints

1. **`:8787` — Tier 1 DNA (`AUTOPHAGE v1.4.0`):** Streams SSE frames containing `ovi`, `traits112`, conservation ledger, and evolved 128-byte `genome_hex`.
2. **`:8788` — Tier 2 Cells (`Cellulogonic Mecha v1.5.0`):** Receives real 128B DNA transfection, 13-vector restraints, solvent overrides, and nutrient plumes; returns `telemetry` and `bridge.traits112`.
3. **`:8791` — Tier 2+ Frontier VM (`Cellular Engine Omega v5.2.0`):** Polled via `/api/run` for `TB13`–`TB16` frontier diagnostics (75 substrates, 1,000-cell hybrid cube).
4. **`:8795` — Tier 3/4 Cognitive (`Noetic Organism Omega v2.1.0`):** Polled via `/api/state` and `/api/e2` for conservation checks and indicator-only cognitive readouts.
5. **`:8794` — Tier 3+4 World #1 (`Asmodensius-Native v1.1.0` WebGL2 via `macro_wild_relay.py`):** Binary `AZST` creature/static/field/shape snapshots and WebSocket stream under strict **`D7RO`** read-only policy.
6. **`:8796` — Tier 3+4 World #2 (`Asmodensius-Native v1.1.0` native `az_view`):** Proxied via `/proxy/macro-live/`, toggleable inside the Hub via `W1:GL2` ⇄ `W2:az_view`.
7. **`:8790` — Unified Hub (`server.mjs` v6.8.0):** Serves UI, `/healthz`, `/api/stack/events` (SSE), `/api/stack/action` (JSON POST), `/api/stack/shape/:clade`, `/api/stack/env-slice`, and `/proxy/*`.
8. **`:8790/zeta-omega/` — Singularity Atlas (`alife-singularity-omega-package v3.4.0`):** Static read-only archive served strictly through `resolveSafePath`.

## 3. Data Flow & Observer Independence (`D7RO`)

- **Allowed Write Paths:** T1 → T2 (`DNA-128B` transfection), T4/T3 → T2 (habitat solvent sync, nutrient plume, shock), Operator → T1+T2 (13-vector restraint parity).
- **Forbidden T1/T2 Write Paths (`D7RO`):** T1 → T3, T1 → T4, T2 → T3, T2 → T4. Verified at three layers: (1) `computeDifferentialsCore` fixes `{ m: "D7RO", s: 0 }` for all four display cells (`Test 5b`, `M3_D7RO_OBSERVER_VIOLATION`), (2) `injectMacroBioFx` preserves `#ifdef PICK` untouched (`Test 5c`), and (3) live loopback wire-spy `Test 5e` (guarded by `M9_D7RO_WIRE_LEAK_SERVER`) records every HTTP request arriving on a mock Asmodensius server during live polling and T1/T2 actions, verifying zero non-`GET` writes in Phase A, strictly read-only `POST /api/inspect {"uid":...}` in Phase B, and zero leaked T1/T2 payload bytes. Out-of-band operator cadence/pause/relaunch controls (`live_macro_rates`, `sync_pause`, `respawn_cosmos`, `ignite_genesis`) and `/proxy/macro/*` iframe pass-through remain separate operator paths.

# Configuration Reference (`docs/configuration.md`)

## Environment Variables (`.env.example`)

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TRISCALE_PORT` | `8790` | Loopback HTTP/SSE/WebSocket bind port on `127.0.0.1`. |
| `OBSERVATORY_NO_ENGINES` | `0` | Set to `1` (or pass `--no-engines`) to serve Hub UI and `/healthz` standalone without spawning sibling engines. |
| `ASMODENSIUS_DEMO_DIR` | Auto-resolved | Optional path override for `Asmodensius-Native/demo` used by `macro_wild_relay.py`. |
| `PYTHON_BIN` | Auto-detected | Optional Python 3.12+ interpreter path used by `tests/test_observatory.mjs` and `scripts/lint_check.mjs`. |
| `TECTONIC_BIN` | Auto-detected | Optional path to Tectonic compiler binary used by `scripts/build_paper.py`. |

## Genesis Studio & Bare-Metal Hardware Parameters

| Parameter | Valid Bounds | Default (`cambrian`) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | `cambrian`, `hyperbrain`, `hyperchaos`, `megaswarm`, `abyss`, `megagrowth`, `million` | `cambrian` | Unknown presets safely fall back to `cambrian`. |
| `n` (Founders) | `1 .. 1,000,000` | `8000` | Clamped identically in Node and Python (`--n`). |
| `cap` (Carrying Capacity) | `0` (auto) or `n .. 2,000,000` | `48000` | `0` invokes `autoCap(n)`. |
| `species` | `1 .. min(100, n)` | `100` | Aligned with upstream `WG_MAX_SPECIES = 100`. |
| `grid` | `"auto"` or `"x,y,z"` with `x,y,z in [2..8]` | `"6,6,5"` | Log2 voxel dimensions (`6,6,5` = `64x64x32`; `7,6,6` = `128x64x64`). |
| `tps` / `sps` | `tps: 0..1000`, `sps: 1..60` | `14` / `12` | `tps=0` runs uncapped; updatable live without restart. |
| `threads` | `0..64` (`0` = auto) | `0` | Worker thread count passed to `az_live.exe`. |
| `kernels` (`--kernels`) | `0` or `1` | `1` | Enables AVX2/AVX-VNNI vector kernels. |
| `ecores` (`--ecores`) | boolean | `true` | Enables all 24 physical cores (8 P-cores + 16 E-cores). |
| `prefetch` (`--prefetch`) | `0` or `1` | `1` | Enables DDR5 streaming software prefetch. |
| `gpu` (`--gpu`) | `0` or `1` | `0` | Enables NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti CUDA PTX sparse brain offload. |
| `largePages` (`--large-pages`) | boolean | `false` | Requests 2 MiB TLB large pages (requires OS privilege). |
| `lesion` | `0x000000 .. 0x7fffff` | `0` | 23-bit behavior/cognition lesion mask (`0` = all 23 active). |
| `lab` / `seed` | boolean / `0 .. 2,147,483,647` | `false` / `42` | `false` = Wild OS entropy; `true` = reproducible seeded Lab mode. |
| `params` | `^[A-Z0-9_]+$` integer map | Preset defaults | Non-whitelisted keys or non-finite values are stripped cleanly. |

## `macro_wild_relay.py` CLI Usage

```bash
# Dry-run JSON contract resolution (works on any OS without Asmodensius-Native present)
python macro_wild_relay.py --preset million --data-dir ./runtime/dry \
  --n 1000000 --cap 0 --species 100 --kernels 1 --ecores --gpu 1 --prefetch 1 --large-pages --dry-run
```

# Threat Model (`docs/threat-model.md`)

STRIDE threat analysis for `omega-triscale-observatory` v6.8.0 (`B36`).

## Trust Boundary

- **Intended Deployment:** Single-user local workstation bound strictly to `127.0.0.1:8790`.
- **Untrusted Adversaries Considered:**
  1. Malicious web pages open in the same browser attempting cross-origin CSRF, DNS-rebinding, or cross-site WebSocket hijacking (CSWSH) against `http://127.0.0.1:8790`.
  2. Malformed URLs, path-traversal payloads, or oversized HTTP bodies targeting static file routes or proxy endpoints.
  3. Malformed/injected Genesis `AZ_PARAM` strings or adversarial CLI arguments attempting command-line injection into `macro_wild_relay.py` / `az_live.exe`.
  4. Corrupted or truncated binary `AZST` packets from upstream engines.

## STRIDE Matrix & Verified Mitigations

| Category | Concrete Threat | Mitigation Implemented | Verification Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Spoofing** | Cross-site page forging `POST /api/stack/action` or WebSocket `/proxy/macro/ws` upgrade (CSRF / CSWSH / DNS rebinding). | `isLoopbackHost`, `isLoopbackOrigin`, `Sec-Fetch-Site` check, and required `Content-Type: application/json` (`isSafeLoopbackRequest`), plus `server.on("upgrade")` Host/Origin guard. Absent `Origin` with loopback `Host` is admitted for non-browser loopback CLI clients (browsers always attach `Origin` on WS upgrades). | `tests/test_observatory.mjs` (`Tests 2c, 3.5, 3.6, 3.8`, live raw-socket TCP WS `Upgrade` `403`/`101` `Test 3b`) + Mutants `M5_CSRF_ORIGIN_BYPASS`, `M7_WS_UPGRADE_CSWSH_BYPASS` |
| **Tampering** | Directory traversal (`../`, `..\`, `%2e%2e`, NUL bytes, Windows drive prefixes) leaking files outside `web/` or `ZETA_PKG_ROOT`. | Canonical `path.relative` containment in `resolveSafePath` rejecting NUL bytes, drive prefixes, UNC paths, and `..`. | `tests/test_observatory.mjs` (`Tests 2c, 3.3`) + Mutant `M1_PATH_TRAVERSAL_BYPASS` |
| **Tampering** | Command/argument injection via Genesis `params`, `grid`, or `lesion` fields passed to `spawn()`. | `spawn()` uses `shell: false` (argument array only); `params` keys strictly whitelisted to `^[A-Z0-9_]+$` with finite integer values; `grid` whitelisted to `auto` or clamped `2..8` triples; `lesion` clamped to `[0, 0x7fffff]`. | `tests/test_observatory.mjs` (`Tests 2a, 2b, 4 [250]`, `6 [18 raw]`) + `tests/test_relay.py` (`120` trials + raw adversarial) |
| **Tampering (Scientific)** | Observer interference mutating `Asmodensius-Native` state or breaking GPU picking. | Fixed `D7RO` (`s: 0`) display cells in `computeDifferentialsCore`; `#ifdef PICK` preserved untouched in `injectMacroBioFx`; zero T1/T2 write paths to `PORTS.macro`. | `tests/test_observatory.mjs` (`Tests 5b, 5c`, live loopback wire-spy `Test 5e`) + Mutants `M3_D7RO_OBSERVER_VIOLATION`, `M9_D7RO_WIRE_LEAK_SERVER` |
| **Information Disclosure** | XSS in UI telemetry rendering from upstream engine strings. | All dynamic DOM interpolations in `web/app.js` escape HTML entities via `esc()` (`&`, `<`, `>`, `"`, `'`); responses emit `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`. | `web/app.js`, `tests/test_observatory.mjs` (`Test 3.2`) |
| **Denial of Service** | Memory exhaustion via unbounded history growth, oversized proxy payloads, or SSE connection floods. | Omnitemporal ring capped `<= 240`; causal log `<= 80`; SSE clients `<= 32` (`429`); request cap `2 MiB` (`413`); proxy response cap `16 MiB` (`502`); JSON body cap `256 KiB`; `az_live` run dirs pruned to `5`. | `tests/test_observatory.mjs` (`Test 5b`) + Mutant `M4_OMNITEMPORAL_CAP_LEAK` |
| **Elevation of Privilege** | Exposing local supervisor over LAN/WAN. | Hard-bound strictly to `127.0.0.1` (`server.listen(HUB_PORT, "127.0.0.1")`); documented explicitly in `SECURITY.md` and `LIMITATIONS.md`. | `server.mjs`, `SECURITY.md` |

# Verification Architecture (`docs/verification.md`)

`omega-triscale-observatory` v6.8.0 implements a multi-layer automated test strategy (example-based, live loopback socket, differential, and seeded-random tests — not formal proofs) for its security, numeric, cross-language, and observer-isolation invariants, with **zero external test frameworks** (pure Node.js `node:test` + Python `unittest`).

## Verification Layers

1. **Syntax & Static Hygiene (`npm run lint` — `B17`/`B18`):**
   - Executes `node --check` on all `9` JS/MJS files and `python -m py_compile` on all `5` Python targets (`macro_wild_relay.py`, `tests/test_relay.py`, `scripts/check_citations.py`, `scripts/build_paper.py`, `scripts/stamp_timestamps.py`).
   - Rejects `eval`, `new Function`, `Math.random()` inside server/core logic, and stale unformed corporate affiliation strings.
   - Paired with `jsconfig.json` (`"checkJs": true`, `"strict": true`) and CI report-only `ruff` + `mypy`.
2. **Contract, Negative, Live HTTP & Raw-Socket WebSocket CSWSH Tests (`tests/test_observatory.mjs` — `B06`/`B09`):**
   - Binds `server.mjs` to ephemeral loopback port `127.0.0.1:0` (closing cleanly in `t.after()` — zero lingering daemons).
   - Verifies `/healthz`, static `nosniff`, 5 distinct path-traversal payloads, HTTP `400` on invalid `clade` and `z`, HTTP `403` on cross-origin CSRF, non-JSON POST, and non-loopback SSE `Host`.
   - `Test 3b`: sends raw TCP `Upgrade: websocket` requests directly to the live listening socket — asserting `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` + socket destruction on foreign `Origin: https://evil.example` (`/ws` and `/proxy/macro/ws`) and non-loopback `Host: evil.example:8790`, plus positive `101 Switching Protocols` control against an ephemeral mock upstream WS server and explicit absent-`Origin` CLI check.
3. **Property-Based Testing (`prop_check` — `B10`):**
   - `250` deterministic seeded randomized trials in Node (`tests/test_observatory.mjs`) + `120` seeded randomized trials in Python (`tests/test_relay.py`) asserting `1 <= n <= 1_000_000`, `n <= cap <= 2_000_000`, `1 <= species <= min(100, n)`, `2 <= grid <= 8`, 23-bit lesion clamping, and exact hardware flag serialization.
4. **Metamorphic, Golden, Offline Conservation & Live Loopback `D7RO` Wire-Spy Tests (`B08`/`B14`/`B21`):**
   - `Test 5a`: 112-trait spectral delta swap antisymmetry (`dna <-> cells`), constant-shift invariance inside `[0, 1]`, and clamping against unclamped `[0..7]` inputs.
   - `Test 5b`: omnitemporal ring cap `<= 240` across `320` consecutive pushes; fail-closed conservation gate testing ALL failure modes: offline required tiers (`t1_dna = false`, `t2_cells = false`, `t4_env = false` with fresh timestamps → `DEGRADED`), stale timestamps (`>= 15 s` → `DEGRADED`), and nonzero DNA/Cells/`observerFail` residuals (`ALERT`).
   - `Test 5c` & `Test 5e`: constant `D7RO` (`s: 0`) cells on `matrix4x4[0..1][2..3]`, `#ifdef PICK` preservation in `injectMacroBioFx`, AND a live 4-server loopback wire-spy test (`mockMacro`, `mockMeso`, `mockMicro`, `mockNoetic`) recording every HTTP method/URL/body on mock Asmodensius during live polling and T1/T2 state updates (`transfect`, `restraints`, `wave_mode`, `meso_pulse`, `env_solvent`, `cells_regime`, `micro_shock`, `cross_mutate_all4`) — asserting zero non-`GET` writes in Phase A, strictly read-only `POST /api/inspect {"uid":...}` in Phase B, and zero leaked T1/T2 payload bytes.
   - `Test 5d`: deterministic `AZST` binary creature decoding and deterministic `web/taxonomy.js` outputs.
5. **Cross-Language Raw-Input Differential Oracle (`B11`/`B12`):**
   - `Test 6`: passes `18` raw unnormalized adversarial and seeded-random configurations (`n` in `{0, -5, 5_000_000, "NaN"}`, `cap = -10`, invalid presets, malformed grids, non-boolean hardware flags `"false"`, `"yes"`, `"2"`, `"banana"`, negative/overflow 23-bit lesion masks) directly WITHOUT pre-normalization to BOTH Node `normalizeGenesisConfig` and Python `macro_wild_relay.py --dry-run`, asserting exact agreement across all `16` resolved output fields.
6. **Planted-Regression Mutation Testing (`scripts/run_mutation_audit.mjs` — `B13`):**
   - Copies the repo into an isolated `os.tmpdir()` directory, plants `9` hand-written logic regressions (`7` in `lib/observatory_core.mjs`, `2` in `server.mjs`), runs the full `14/14` Node test suite against each mutant, asserts **9/9** killed, and removes the temporary directory without dirtying `results/mutation_audit.json` (`git diff --exit-code` enforced in CI). This is a kill rate for these nine targeted mutants, not a repo-wide automated mutation score across all arithmetic or UI lines.
7. **Live Crossref/DataCite Citation, Dual Timestamp & Clean-Room White Paper Verification:**
   - `scripts/check_citations.py`: live Handle reachability + Crossref/DataCite title & author match + zero-retraction check across all `13/13` entries in `paper/refs.bib` (`10/10` DOIs, `5/5` URLs, `1` print MIT Press proceedings entry `bedau1998` with no wrong DOI), recorded in `results/citation-audit.json`.
   - `scripts/stamp_timestamps.py --verify`: verifies DigiCert RFC 3161 (`CHECKSUMS.sha256.tsr`) + 3-calendar Bitcoin OpenTimestamps (`CHECKSUMS.sha256.ots`) cryptographically bind `CHECKSUMS.sha256`.
   - `scripts/build_paper.py --verify-only`: Tectonic compilation failing on ANY Overfull `\hbox`, undefined ref/citation, or missing character + deterministic `arxiv_submission.tar.gz` clean-room rebuild without overwriting the committed PDF, so CI SLSA provenance attests BOTH committed `dist/` deliverables.

# Benchmarks & Performance Budgets (`docs/benchmarks.md`)

All measurements below were collected directly via `node scripts/benchmark_observatory.mjs` (`results/benchmarks.json`) with **zero fabricated numbers**.

## Environment

- **Version:** `v6.8.0`
- **Runtime:** Node.js `v25.8.2` (`win32-x64`)
- **Date:** `2026-11-26`
- **Harness:** `scripts/benchmark_observatory.mjs` (deterministic SplitMix32 workload, 20-iteration JIT warmup)

## Measured Latency vs. Performance Budgets (`A37` / `B26`)

| Workload | Payload / Iterations | Mean (ms) | p50 (ms) | p95 (ms) | p99 (ms) | Budget (p95) | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `computeDifferentialsCore` | 112-trait Δ + 8-axis `cosθ` + D7RO (`1,000` iters) | `0.0504` | `0.0401` | `0.1169` | `0.2615` | `<= 2.0 ms` | PASS |
| `decodeAzstCreaturesCore` | `10,000`-creature binary `AZST` (`100` iters) | `3.1278` | `3.1040` | `4.1033` | `4.6251` | `<= 30.0 ms` | PASS |
| `normalizeGenesisConfig + buildRelayArgs` | `1,000,000` bare-metal config (`1,000` iters) | `0.0191` | `0.0129` | `0.0344` | `0.1585` | `<= 1.0 ms` | PASS |
| `resolveSafePath` | Traversal + valid path pair (`2,000` iters) | `0.0130` | `0.0103` | `0.0202` | `0.0539` | `<= 0.5 ms` | PASS |

## Memory & Resource Budgets

- **Omnitemporal History Ring:** Strictly capped at `<= 240` entries (`MAX_OMNITEMPORAL_HISTORY = 240`), guaranteeing bounded O(1) memory growth regardless of session duration.
- **Causal Event Log:** Strictly capped at `<= 80` entries in memory (`24` serialized per SSE frame).
- **Concurrent SSE Clients:** Hard cap of `32` concurrent subscribers (`429 Too Many Requests` above cap).
- **Proxy Body Caps:** `2 MiB` request cap (`413`), `16 MiB` buffered rewrite response cap (`502`), `256 KiB` JSON action body cap.

## Tracking Over Time (`B27`)

Every CI run executes `npm run bench` in report-only mode and uploads `results/benchmarks.json` as a build artifact for historical regression comparison.

# Frequently Asked Questions (`docs/faq.md`)

### 1. Can I run and test `omega-triscale-observatory` without cloning the 6 sibling repositories?
Yes. Every automated test (`npm test`, `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`, `npm run lint`, `npm run mutate`, `npm run bench`, `python scripts/stamp_timestamps.py --verify`) and standalone server mode (`npm run start:standalone` or `node server.mjs --no-engines`) runs cleanly from a standalone clone with zero sibling repositories on disk and zero npm/pip installs.

### 2. Does this repository contain Lean 4 formal proofs?
No. `omega-triscale-observatory` contains **0 local Lean 4 files**. It is strictly a visualization, reverse-proxy, metrology, and orchestration hub. The `327` combined upstream Lean 4.35.0 proofs displayed in the ecosystem summary (`48 + 70 + 89 + 54 + 30 + 36`) live in, and are reported as checked by, their six respective sibling repositories; they are not audited in this repository.

### 3. Does the Hub mutate `Asmodensius-Native` while observing it?
No T1/T2 state is ever written into `Asmodensius-Native` (`:8794` / `:8796`). This `D7RO` convention is verified across three automated layers in `v6.8.0`: (1) the displayed T1/T2-to-T3/T4 coupling cells are fixed at `{ m: "D7RO", s: 0 }` (`Test 5b`, `M3`), (2) client-side WebGL2 Bio-FX shader injection leaves `#ifdef PICK` intact (`Test 5c`), and (3) live loopback wire-spy `Test 5e` (guarded by `server.mjs` mutant `M9_D7RO_WIRE_LEAK_SERVER`) records every HTTP method, URL, and payload arriving on a mock Asmodensius socket during polling and T1/T2 actions, verifying zero non-`GET` writes in Phase A and strictly read-only `POST /api/inspect {"uid":...}` on specimen lock in Phase B. Out-of-band operator cadence/pause/relaunch commands (`live_macro_rates`, `sync_pause`, `respawn_cosmos`, `ignite_genesis`) and `/proxy/macro/*` iframe pass-through remain separate operator controls.

### 4. Does this observatory solve any open problems in the Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas?
No. **`0 / 1,900` overarching Mega-Atlas open problems are solved or retired.** The observatory is an empirical telemetry and orchestration instrument supporting exploration related to `AI-045`, `SYS-009`, and `SYS-050`, each of which remains strictly **OPEN** (`docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md`).

### 5. Is `differential.chaosLyapunov` a real Lyapunov exponent?
No. It is a bounded `[0, 1]` heuristic combining rolling telemetry step deltas and Shannon entropies for UI trend monitoring (`LIMITATIONS.md`).

### 6. Why does `server.mjs` reject requests from non-loopback hosts or external browser tabs?
To prevent cross-site request forgery (CSRF) and cross-site WebSocket hijacking (CSWSH) against local simulation controls (`docs/threat-model.md`), verified directly by live HTTP and raw-socket TCP WebSocket `Upgrade` `403` tests (`Test 3` and `Test 3b`). Always access the Hub via `http://127.0.0.1:8790/` or `http://localhost:8790/`.
